description:
(Automatic, always active) From being a half human, half dragon, immunity to fire, ice, thunder/electricity, and partial resistance to poison.
Half zarakites are also immune to mental and psychic attack of all kind, as well as possession (demonic and otherwise) and mind control.
name: Half Zarakite Dragon Immunities
note:
<cgmzdesc:
These immunities and resistances aren't just at skin level.  The 'sponge' tissue underneath zarakite and half-zarakite skin also has them.

As for immunity to any attack that is psychic or close to mind control of some sort, this is due to how zarakites and half zarakites have their brains located in extra-dimensional space, and tethered via connective tissues of a special sort to their body parts in standard space.  Extradimensional space is a custom dimension and small realm outside of but specially connected to the rest of a zarakite or half zarakites body parts in the normal, same dimension as their skin, sponge, and their human friends and so on.  Having their internal body parts split up like this yet connected with connective tissues is normal for a zarakite or half zarakite, and how their bodies are supposed to live.  Signals and blood are transmitted back and forth among all of these body parts, inside themselves.  That's the best way to explain it for the moment.  So with their brain tissue safely tucked away and protected as such, anything that goes into their heads and behind their faces only goes through filler sponge tissue, because that's what is inside their skulls, and not where they keep their brains.

Regarding the high resistance to poison, zarakite dragons and half zarakites have very well developed and superior immune systems and related biology that works far better, faster, and more efficiently than that of any human.  They are immune to sexually transmitted diseases, don't get common colds or the flu, and can't even carry stuff they are immune to very easily because their biology wipes out such nasty things so easily that viruses, pathogens, and other bad things simply can't survive very long, or at all, inside of zarakite blood and other biology.  Zarakites don't get sick.  Half zarakites, the same.  These things don't weaken over the years, either, unlike with humans, and other Earth-origin life.
>

description:
(Automatic, always active) Half zarakites don't physically age beyond 16 years of age, regardless of chronological age.  This includes immunity to baldness and
age-related disorders.  Their voices don't ever sound older than that of a 16-year old, either.  They always appear youthful, for life.
name: Half Zarakite Dragon Immunities

description:
(Automatic, always active) Half zarakites have superior physical strength, reflexes, reaction times, and dexterity compared to pure humans, all of which are beyond
what pure humans are capable of having at any age.  This affects many combat stats behind the scenes that are not listed.
name: Half Zarakite Dragon Qualities

description:
(Automatic, always active) Half zarakites are athletic, have non-bulky muscles, and can eat however much they want and never gain weight,
and do not need to exercise or lift weights for such.  They eat a human omnivore diet (same as regular pure human).
name: Half Zarakite Dragon Qualities

description:
(Automatic, always active) Half-zarakites do not have sweat glands and don't naturally develop any unpleasant body odor.  Some but not all zarakites have pure snow
white skin.  \P[1] has pure white dragon skin of this type, perfect, unblemished, regenerating, and healing without ever scarring or leaving marks.
name: Half Zarakite Dragon Qualities

description:
(Automatic, always active) Half-zarakite skin layers provide many immunities.  Sentient monsters will kidnap half-zarakites, skin them, and trade their half-dragon
hide on their market, as it can be made into clothing, shields, furniture, and more that is immune to fire, and so on.
name: Half Zarakite Dragon Qualities

description:
(Automatic, always active) Being born a pure human female, then turned into a half-dragon during junior high school,
such people can sometimes (but not usually) enjoy better strength and speed, but not as much as their male counterparts.
name: Female Half Dragon Qualities
note:
<cgmzdesc:
The female version of a half dragon, one that was born pure human, enjoys a lot of immunities, life-long youth, dragon skin of some color, and regrowth and healing abilities much like the male version does, but when it comes to physical strength, dexterity, speed and reflexes, such qualities are usually the same as being pure human, not much better if at all than what the female was born with by nature.

In rare cases though, such a female will have better strength and speed and so on than a pure human, something like the male gender half-zarakite, but although better than what a pure human could have, the boost that they develop from getting turned into a half-dragon is not anywhere near as extreme as what the male gender counterpart enjoys.  Still, what the female gender version gets isn't really something to complain about.

\P[2] is one of these rare cases, getting these types of increased physical capabilities to her physical strength, speed, and reflexes, along with what all female half-zarakites enjoy, a thin and slender athletic body that cannot become obese or even slightly overweight, dragon skin of some color that becomes perfect and unblemished and heals without scars or signs of ever being damaged, as well as immunity to fire, ice, and electrical damage, etc.

\P[2] has caucasian white skin instead of pure white skin, only because caucasian white skin is what she was born with, even though her new half-dragon version of her skin has those immunities, which of course she wasn't born with.  Her DNA of her body now has a mix of her original pure human DNA and some zarakite DNA that she got from her boyfriend.

Just like half-zarakites who are male, half-zarakites who are female are biologically and physically unable to have children, and unable to get pregnant, just as \P[1] is unable to make any female pregnant.  No birth control measures are ever needed.  This is simply how half-zarakites are.  \P[2] also enjoys extreme, if not total resistance and immunity to sexually-transmitted diseases and similar conditions, as well as far less chance of carrying things they are immune to.  \P[1] and \P[2] are both like this, and so are zarakite dragons.

To be direct and to the point, \P[1] magically altered \P[2]'s anatomy and DNA, turning \P[2] into a half-dragon, via frequent sexual intercourse, beginning in junior high school.  The two had already known each other since grade school, and have always been in the same grade and many of the same classes as each other, specifically as far back as second grade, starting as simple friends, where \P[2] found that she was interested in \P[1] and his hobbies, and started socializing and spending time with him and other boys who knew \P[1].  From this, she learned a lot about what boys talk about and do with each other at a young age, and she learned how to have fun much like the boys did, and join \P[1] and his friends for what they enjoyed doing.

\P[2] has made a commitment that she is solid and firm with, which is to remain what she is and what \P[1] turned her into, and stay with \P[1] for a life-long experience.  She has already stuck to this and made it clear to her parents and \P[1]'s parents, as well as \P[1] himself, who have all accepted this.  \P[1] and \P[2] are inseperable.
>

description:
Cut off your own head.  This doesn't kill you, and actually has it's uses.  Note that this injures yourself a little, dropping your HP slightly.  Thanks to being a
half-dragon, you are a magical creature and handle this sort of thing easily.  You can re-attach it later.  You can also USE it in your inventory for stuff.
name: Decapitate self
note:
<cgmzdesc:
When decapitated, even if you carry your severed head with you, without it being attached you lose a LOT of combat bonuses, including extra actions for every combat turn, although that's only the beginning of the drawbacks you'll suffer from.

If you are decapitated, you can still breathe fire in combat by holding your head and aiming your mouth at enemies.

When you cut off your head, or if it gets chopped or cut off in combat, your body has more than one brain connected to it's parts, and one of your brains will control your headless body while another brain of yours will control and think for it's decapitated head.  Normally, when you are complete with all parts attached and nothing broken, your multiple brains are in sync with each other, giving you one single mind and intellect you think with that is in your primary brain, and all other brains you have sync with that primary brain and share it's short and long-term memories.  When your head gets severed, your brains de-sync with each other, and think independently, but have copies of the same memories, thoughts, emotions, and ideas up until that point.  They retain the same personality, and given the same experiences will come up with the same ideas, thoughts, emotions, actions, and would say the same things in conversations.

Note that when your head is decapitated, even though you have two parts of yourself thinking with two different brains, you are still one single person, and the same person.  You might notice that when your head is cut off it will refer to your body's parts and actions, in conversation, as it's own.  If you are indoors and your headless body is putting it's shoes on, your severed head might say "...Yeah, just a sec, I'm getting my shoes on right now..." and NOT refer to your body as any separate "person" or entity, but instead as itself.  If someone grabs one of your shoes and holds it high in the air, like a bully at school, your head won't say "give my body it's shoe back" as this is improper, but instead say "Hey, give me my shoe back!"  You can then hold out your hand and say "Come on, hand it back to me!" which would be grammatically and culturally correct for a half-zarakite and a zarakite.  If you have to specify and differentiate between your two parts, and perhaps their minds or intellects, you can say with your head "No, don't just drop my shoe in front of my head, give it to the rest of me, over by the bench!  See me waving and holding my hand out?  That's the rest of me!  Give me my shoe back!"  Again, you only have one single "me" even though it may be split up into "some of yourself" being severed and being tossed in a game of basketball with your friends, while "the rest of yourself" is sitting on a bench holding your hand out, wanting YOUR (not "it's", typically) shoe to be handed back to yourself.  It is NORMAL for half-zarakites and zarakites to think and talk this way, and well-ingrained in culture.

When you talk to yourself, with your head speaking to your decapitated body, you're talking to yourself, not a seperate person or seperate identity, again with how zarakites and half-zarakites are raised and taught to think and talk.  If your primary brain is linked and tethered to your headless body, and you drop your head on a couch, then start to leave the living room you might be in, your head will sometimes say "Hey, don't leave your head here, pick it back up and carry it to your bedroom so we can talk to \P[2] who's waiting there!"  but can also say "Hey, don't leave me here, take me with you to your bedroom so we can talk to \P[2] who's waiting there!"  Both versions are considered grammatically and culturally correct and proper, for zarakites and half-zarakites like yourself.  These special language rules and so on apply to when you are talking to yourself, but not anyone else.  You can even go back and forth between the two ways of speaking, when your talking to yourself, although this can sound confusing and be a bit akward to other people who are nearby and listening, and might bug your high school English teacher a bit, who might feel like they should "correct" you for doing such a thing, even though zarakite dragon grammar rules don't forbid it.  Your English teacher in high school, by the way \P[1], is a human, and sometimes humans can be like that.  Whatever.  Being half human, you would think you would understand with that human side of yours, but you really don't.  Maybe its because humans don't talk to themselves when they are decapitated or dismembered, as doing that sort of thing is zarakite dragon stuff.
>

description:
Re-attach your head, if it is severed, and if you are carrying your severed head.  This restores many
half-dragon combat bonuses, and removes plenty of penalties to all sorts of scores and calculations in combat.
name: Re-attach head
note:
<cgmzdesc:
To re-attach your head to yourself, you must have your head in your party's shared inventory.  If you don't because you left it somewhere, or something happened to it, then of course you can't re-attach it.

Re-attaching your head also recovers a few Hit Points, as the process involves regrowing and healing some tissues of course.

You cannot re-attach your head if your head has had it's bottom area, or stump, melted or burned with acid, or anything similar done to it's flesh and tissues.  If your muscles, tendons, nerves, and skin are damaged like this, you can select this ability under options anyways, and see if this game gives you an option to stab and kill your head, which allows you to grow a brand new one.  This means throwing out your old head you killed, along with any memories of what it has seen and heard while it was severed from the rest of your body.

Reconnecting your head to your neck, if an available option, re-syncs your multiple brains you have, so that you effectively think and behave with one single mind and intellect again.  When you re-sync as you re-connect your severed head, you merge short-term and long-term memories of both brains, so that your primary brain and your in-sync other brains have copies of experiences from both your body and your head.  This means if your head was watching TV in a downstairs living room, and your headless body was upstairs in your bedroom of your house playing video games, when you reconnect your head you have memories of both the television show and the video game you played, memories of being both your severed head and your headless body, including any conversations that both parts of you may have been involved in, things your head said and talked about, and what your body listened to and did with any hand signals or body language.  (Typing text and handwriting is stuff your headless body can certainly do with it's head nowhere nearby.)
>

description:
Re-grow a new head, which only works if you've been decapitated and your old head got killed.
If your old head still lives, this won't work, even if you've misplaced it!
name: Re-grow new head
note:
<cgmzdesc:
Sometimes, you don't have your head anymore, for whatever reason, and have to regenerate/regrow a new one.  No worries, your new head will always grow back to be just as good as the last one you had, complete with it's stylish flat-top hair style and blond hair, the same freckle pattern, and it's beautiful and PERFECT pure-white skin.  Don't forget about your brand new half-dragon eyes with their vivid, intense blue irises, that grow back with it.  It will talk, eat, sing, flirt with \P[2], and mouth off at bad schoolteachers that are unfair and deserve it, all exactly the same as your last head, no worries.

Your non-primary brain, if it was connected to your head, will still be intact and just fine afterwards, and re-synced with your primary brain, healthy and ready for being decapitated once again whenever that happens.

Your new head regrows PERFECTLY, according to your DNA for it that is protected in extradimensional space along with your brains, so that it NEVER degrades or wears down over the years of your 100-year half-dragon life, ever, no matter what experiences you go through.

Your new head does NOT need any orthodontics or any teeth straightened or corrected, so no need for braces or "fixing" anything that isn't broken with your perfect new head grown exactly according to your pure DNA.  Genetically, your teeth are already, by nature, perfectly straight and aligned as they should be and need to be, so you have nothing to worry about with any of that stuff.

Your new eyes see and otherwise work just as good as your old ones.  The list goes on.  Everything works the same.

Your blond dragon hair regenerates and grows with it, including some length to it and in your flat-top style your hair is always in by nature.

This ability is actually very healthy for you, as you fix and correct any tooth decay or damage, fix some things that your ears/eardrums may have put up with if you went to a loud rock concert wearing your old head on your neck, etc.  Regrowing a new head is refreshing, healthy, and more.  It also feels good to replace and regrow fresh body parts, being a half-dragon.  Humans, by comparison, get the short end of the stick here, with the same body parts for many long years, including the same tissues, the same joints, the same tendons and muscles and connective tissues, and the same nerves, all of which wear down and break more easily and darn near rot away over the years.  Its a big part of how humans get old, frail, hobbled, and crippled with time, one of those "human things" that half-dragons like you, \P[1], never have to worry about.  Other "human stuff" you never go through includes getting weak, tired, no longer having youthful energy anything close to what one has as a child, diabetes, heart attacks, wrinkles and liver spots, baldness, arthritis, ED, and a whole bunch of other really disgusting and unholy NASTY "human stuff" you wouldn't want to ever get into and don't need to ever worry about.  No really, just ask your human teenage friends, like \P[3] and \P[4], and their parents.  Yikes.
>

description: Regenerates several damaged body parts, healing yourself.  This works thanks to being a half-dragon or a dragon.
name: Regrow body parts (Heal self)
note:
<cgmzdesc:
You don't need to specify the body parts to heal or get rid of in favor of growing new ones, as they are automatically chosen when you use this ability.  The exception is your head, if you are decapitated, which has special rules and stuff with your half-dragon or dragon magic.

Using this ability means killing the detached body part and then discarding it, to regrow a new replacement body part you get rid of.

This uses up some of your nutrition, which you get back over time, especially by eating food, in other words Special Points, which represent your own body's energy, nutrition, health other than Hit Points, and biological reserves of your body's organs and tissues.

When wounded, repeated use of this ability heals a small percentage of your maximum Hit Points every time.  The trade-off for using your body's natural reserves like this is about 5 percent of your maximum Hit Points, give or take.  With maximum Special Points available, you can use this ability five times before having to regain any of those Special Points.

This sort of ability is very normal and natural for your half-dragon biology, is something you're supposed to do with your body and it's parts because you are a half-zarakite dragon, and is something your body kinda does all the time anyways whether you want it to or not, without you even thinking about it.  Your body is always regenerating and regrowing a little, always correcting and fixing stuff that in pure-blooded humans causes aging and age-related disorders.  Unlike a pure human, your body parts never wear down or wear out over the years, and stay youthful, energetic, and brand spanking new in a way as years and decades go by, keeping your body just like that of a teenager, life-long.  This is related to how you will still look like a sixteen-year-old teenager when you are 99 years old, thanks to your half-zarakite magical nature and this regrowth and regenerating that is always going on in your body's cells and tissues, very slowly all the time, and more rapidly when you voluntarily and deliberately regrow specific parts or regions with your natural innate magic.  It keeps you young, healthy, durable, and even kind of "made of rubber" the way children can be, able to horseplay, brawl, crash into things while running around and otherwise getting physical, etc., and just get back up and start running some more without being injured, unlike a human who is an elderly man or woman who is bent over and shuffles around with a walker, and has arthritis, baldness, diabetes half the time, frail bones that are weak, ED, and a bunch of other "human stuff" related to old age that is honestly quite disgusting.  Good thing you never have to worry about any of that, \P[1], as you have this and other innate and natural dragon-related magical abilities your whole life.
>

description: Being a half-dragon of a certain type, \P[1] can make healthy, plain drinking water upon request, as a magical ability of his.
name: Create drinking water x1
note:
<cgmzdesc:
Food and drink items often, but not always, will increase not only Hit Points, but also Special Points as well, if they give general nutrition, protein, and such to one who consumes it.  This means that most food and drink items are good at restoring a character's abilities to use special or innate powers or abilities, when those abilities depend on some sort of nutrition, or focus and concentration, or physical effort that can wear one out, or other biological reserves of their body's cells and-or tissues.  For magical creatures, this can also include natural innate magic.  Yes, this certainly includes \P[1].

Aside from Special Points being restored, eating food and consuming drinks typically also restores small amounts of Hit Points, but usually less than that of healing potions.

A few food items, but not many, also restore Magic Points, of the kind that combat mages, wizards, and witches use for casting spells.
>

description:
Being a half-dragon of a certain type, \P[1] can make healthy, delicious dragon syrup upon request, as a magical ability of his.
\P[1] makes only lemon-flavored syrup, as he has blond hair.  (The dragon magic is weird like this, its just how it works.)
name: Create Dragon Syrup x1
note:
<cgmzdesc:
Becuase of how zarakite dragon magic works, the creator's hair color determines color and flavor.  Blond haired zarakites and half-zarakites, like yourself for example, make lemon-flavored food that is blond or yellow-colored, and sugary sweet.

If you had orange hair (what many call red hair), then the syrup and candy you magically create would be orange-colored and would taste like sweetened orange.

Vivid red hair, red like cherries and fire trucks, means red-colored foods with a sweet strawberry taste.

Blue hair means a sweet blueberry taste, and purple means a sweet grape flavor.  Brown and Black mean chocolate and dark chocolate flavors.  The list goes on.

The color and flavor affect nutrition from eating them slightly.

These magically created foods are primarily treats, candy, and desserts, even though some are healthy and nutritious.  Most of them DO contain sugar of some sort regardless.
>

\P[1] makes only sweet lemon-flavored frosting, as he has blond hair.  (The dragon magic is weird like this, its just how it works.)
name: Create Dragon Frosting x5
note:
<cgmzdesc:
Becuase of how zarakite dragon magic works, the creator's hair color determines color and flavor.  Blond haired zarakites and half-zarakites, like yourself for example, make lemon-flavored food that is blond or yellow-colored, and sugary sweet.

If you had orange hair (what many call red hair), then the syrup and candy you magically create would be orange-colored and would taste like sweetened orange.

Vivid red hair, red like cherries and fire trucks, means red-colored foods with a sweet strawberry taste.

Blue hair means a sweet blueberry taste, and purple means a sweet grape flavor.  Brown and Black mean chocolate and dark chocolate flavors.  The list goes on.

The color and flavor affect nutrition from eating them slightly.

These magically created foods are primarily treats, candy, and desserts, even though some are healthy and nutritious.  Most of them DO contain sugar of some sort regardless.
>
